findings.text: the delta validates quadrature.cut_batch_width at :475 and then ignores it for the primal path, deriving batch_width from the fixed _PRIMAL_CUT_BATCH_WIDTH at :479, so a caller that sets the documented Quadrature knob silently gets a 32-cell primal tile while book_tangent_channels at :813 still honours the same value; the two booking paths now disagree about what one option means, and a sweep that varies cut_batch_width no longer varies the primal booking it measures.

no assertion covers the property this delta actually changes: reverting _PRIMAL_CUT_BATCH_WIDTH to 16 leaves every test green, because moment parity and the booking byte pins are indifferent to the cut tile and the only evidence the 32-cell tile survives is the manually run propagation count in restructure/comparison.json (base 672, prior 1344, head 672); the launch regression the prior review blocked is therefore unguarded against recurrence.

book_tangent still writes the same tile as a bare literal (batch_width = 32) while the delta introduces _PRIMAL_CUT_BATCH_WIDTH for that exact value at :65, so the one number now has a name in one path and a magic literal in the other and the two can drift apart silently.
